content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have set up a [product_name] to record data onto an SD card successfully. My question is whether it's possible to customize the data headers in the CSV files for the data blocks. I’ve assigned the block names in the program, but the headers in the file don’t reflect these names. I’ve attached a screenshot highlighting the fields I want to modify, as this would help make the information clearer for our client. Thank you, [user_name]
The [product_name] device itself does not provide this functionality. You can only modify the CSV file headers later using Excel or a text editor during file evaluation.

Thank you for your response. When the [product_name] creates files on the SD card, the filenames are numbered, which is fine. However, the device uses technical block identifiers like B053 AQ, B055 AQ, and B012 Cnt for column headers. I wish to rename these so that, when viewing the log in Excel, the column headings are more descriptive for our customer, for example, changing B053 AQ to 'Total litres'.
I understand your point. My answer remains unchanged.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking to customize column titles in CSV files exported directly from [product_name] devices. The exported files currently use technical identifiers, which are not intuitive for end customers, meaning manual adjustment is needed after export for clarity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to define or personalize CSV file column headings directly in [product_name] software or device, so that exported logs are immediately clear and user-friendly for customers, eliminating the need for further manual editing.
